"""External packaging guards. No command executes merely by importing this module."""

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

if not __debug__:
    raise RuntimeError("Assertions are required; do not optimize this helper.")
PACKAGE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INTEGRATION = Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-integration-preparation-20261012")
ROOT = Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-20261012")
PY = "/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-195-20261011/.venv/bin/python"
BASE = "6435622d08d0a3a8998968eaa96736c702550e9c"
TREE = "428c9ff0ab1294c2e4b5d6059d45a40ddf096974"
TARGET = "data/pathways/l-lyxose-degradation.yaml"
TARGET_ID = "MetaCyc:LYXMET-PWY"
TARGET_SHA = "8ca651dc70a0dda2620ba09719a4e6861517d39f1736ca1971f283900accc121"
PAGE = "pages/records/MetaCyc_LYXMET-PWY.html"
DOSSIER = "research/pathway_additions/2026-10-12-next-227"
SCIENCE = Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-science-successor-review-20261012")
AUDIT = Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-canonical-review-20261012")
ORIGINAL_SCIENCE = Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-227-science-review-20261012")
GATES = ["render", "skills", "validate", "tests", "lint", "kgx", "vendored", "diff-check"]


def now():
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def sha(path):
    d = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
            d.update(block)
    return d.hexdigest()


def bind(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {"path": str(p), "bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(p)}


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def write(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


def verify(binding):
    p = Path(binding["path"])
    assert p.is_file() and sha(p) == binding["sha256"], p
    if "bytes" in binding:
        assert p.stat().st_size == binding["bytes"], p
    return p


def relative(value):
    p = Path(value)
    assert not p.is_absolute() and ".." not in p.parts and str(p) not in ("", ".")
    return str(p)


def external_new(path):
    p = Path(path).absolute()
    assert not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink(), p
    assert p.parent.is_dir() and p.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(Path("/private/tmp"))
    protected = [
        ROOT,
        INTEGRATION,
        PACKAGE,
        SCIENCE,
        AUDIT,
        ORIGINAL_SCIENCE,
        Path("/private/tmp/pathwaymech-curation-authorities"),
    ]
    accepted = read(INTEGRATION / "accepted-inputs.json")
    protected += [Path(v["handoff"]["path"]).parent for v in accepted["packages"].values()]
    assert not any(p.resolve().is_relative_to(x.resolve()) for x in protected), p
    return p


def integration():
    if (PACKAGE / "handoff.json").is_file():
        handoff = read(PACKAGE / "handoff.json")
        verify(handoff["manifest"])
        for item in read(handoff["manifest"]["path"])["artifacts"]:
            verify({**item, "path": str(PACKAGE / item["relative_path"])})
    pins = read(PACKAGE / "accepted-bindings.json")
    for item in pins["files"]:
        verify(item)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "lyxose_integration_common", INTEGRATION / "common.py"
    )
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    mod.verify_package()
    return mod


def current():
    mod = integration()
    mod.validate_base(ROOT, BASE, clean=False)
    mod.verify_adopted(ROOT)
    return mod


def inventory(root):
    p = subprocess.run(
        [
            "rg",
            "--files",
            "--no-ignore",
            "--hidden",
            "--follow",
            "-g",
            "!.git",
            "-g",
            "!.git/**",
            "-g",
            "!.venv",
            "-g",
            "!.venv/**",
            ".",
        ],
        cwd=root,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert p.returncode in (0, 1) and not p.stderr, p.stderr
    return sorted(relative(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines())


def wrapper(original):
    body = Path(original).read_bytes()
    text = body.decode("utf-8")
    assert text.encode("utf-8") == body
    return {
        "serialization": "lossless-utf8-json",
        "original": bind(original),
        "content_status": "unchanged_original_bytes_encoded_as_text",
        "text": text,
    }


def run(label, args, output, mutation=False, apply=False):
    assert not mutation or apply, "Maintained mutation requires explicit --apply by root."
    output = Path(output)
    assert output.is_dir() and not (output / (label + "-execution.json")).exists()
    command = [PY, "-B", *args]
    env = {
        **os.environ,
        "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        "UV_NO_SYNC": "1",
        "PYTHONPATH": str(ROOT / "src") + os.pathsep + str(ROOT),
    }
    started = now()
    p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True)
    streams = {}
    for name in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
        dest = output / (label + "." + name)
        with dest.open("xb") as f:
            f.write(getattr(p, name))
        streams[name] = bind(dest)
    receipt = {
        "started_at": started,
        "finished_at": now(),
        "command": command,
        "cwd": str(ROOT),
        "environment": {k: env[k] for k in ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE", "UV_NO_SYNC", "PYTHONPATH"]},
        "exit_code": p.returncode,
        **streams,
    }
    write(output / (label + "-execution.json"), receipt)
    assert p.returncode == 0, str(output / (label + ".stderr"))
    return p.stdout


def input_config(path):
    cfg = read(path)
    assert cfg["root"] == str(ROOT) and cfg["base"] == BASE and cfg["target_sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    required = [
        "adoption",
        "gates",
        "preservation",
        "tested_inputs",
        "page_qa",
        "visual_observation",
        "root_assessment",
    ]
    for key in required:
        verify(cfg[key])
    observed = read(PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json")
    assert cfg["tested_inputs"] == observed["actual_tested_inputs"]
    assert cfg["adoption"] == observed["actual_adoption"]
    for item in cfg.get("additional_artifacts", []):
        verify(item["original"])
        relative(item["name"])
        assert item["mode"] in {"exact", "lossless_utf8", "credential_header_projection"}
        if Path(item["original"]["path"]).suffix in {
            ".py",
            ".sh",
            ".txt",
            ".stdout",
            ".stderr",
            ".log",
            ".patch",
            ".diff",
        }:
            assert item["mode"] == "lossless_utf8"
        if item["mode"] == "credential_header_projection":
            assert item.get("projection_description") and item.get("full_original")
            verify(item["full_original"])
    return cfg


def check_inputs(cfg):
    mod = current()
    adoption = read(cfg["adoption"]["path"])
    assert adoption["status"] == "adopted_pending_maintained_gates_and_saved_review"
    assert adoption["base"] == BASE and adoption["root"] == str(ROOT)
    assert adoption["target"]["sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    for key in ["baseline", "baseline_kgx"]:
        verify(adoption[key])
    baseline = read(adoption["baseline"]["path"])
    assert baseline["head"] == BASE and baseline["tree"] == TREE
    for group in ["records", "pages", "reviews", "history"]:
        for item in baseline[group]:
            mod.verify(ROOT / item["relative_path"], item, allow_symlink=True)
    assert sum(x["relative_path"].endswith(".yaml") for x in baseline["records"]) == 227
    assert sum(x["relative_path"].endswith("/review.yaml") for x in baseline["reviews"]) == 101
    gates = read(cfg["gates"]["path"])
    assert gates["status"] == "passed" and gates["base"] == BASE
    assert gates["target_sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    assert [x["name"] for x in gates["receipts"]] == GATES
    for item in gates["receipts"]:
        assert item["exit_code"] == 0 and item["cwd"] == str(ROOT)
        for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
            verify(item[stream])
    for item in gates["generated_files"]:
        mod.verify(ROOT / item["relative_path"], item)
    preservation = read(cfg["preservation"]["path"])
    assert preservation["status"] == "passed" and preservation["problems"] == []
    assert preservation["target_sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    assert preservation["gate_receipt"]["sha256"] == cfg["gates"]["sha256"]
    assert (
        preservation["old_record_count"],
        preservation["old_page_count"],
        preservation["old_review_bundles"],
        preservation["new_edges"],
    ) == (227, 227, 101, 111)
    assert preservation["old_edge_cells_exact"] and not preservation["lost_contexts"]
    assert not preservation["unexpected_context_nodes"]
    assessment = read(cfg["root_assessment"]["path"])
    assert assessment["status"] == "accepted" and assessment["target_sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    for key in ["gates", "preservation", "tested_inputs", "page_qa", "visual_observation"]:
        assert assessment["bindings"][key] == cfg[key]
    assert assessment["page"]["path"] == str(ROOT / PAGE)
    verify(assessment["page"])
    assert assessment["coverage"]["graph_edges"] == 111
    assert assessment["coverage"]["endpoint_qualifiers"] == 10
    assert assessment["gate_summary"].strip() and assessment["visual_summary"].strip()
    assert assessment["limitations"] and isinstance(assessment["limitations"], list)
    if preservation["node_display_delta"]:
        for key in ["display_approval", "display_assessment"]:
            verify(cfg[key])
            assert assessment["bindings"][key] == cfg[key]
        assert read(cfg["display_approval"]["path"]) == preservation["node_display_delta"]
        assert (
            preservation["approved_node_display_delta"]["sha256"]
            == cfg["display_approval"]["sha256"]
        )
    checkpoint = read(cfg["tested_inputs"]["path"])
    assert checkpoint["root"] == str(ROOT) and checkpoint["base"] == BASE
    assert checkpoint["adoption"]["sha256"] == cfg["adoption"]["sha256"]
    tested = {x["relative_path"]: x["sha256"] for x in checkpoint["files"]}
    assert len(tested) == len(checkpoint["files"])
    for path, digest in tested.items():
        assert sha(ROOT / relative(path)) == digest, path
    assert TARGET in tested and tested[TARGET] == TARGET_SHA
    for name in ["nodes.tsv", "edges.tsv"]:
        assert sha(ROOT / "output/kgx" / name) == sha(ROOT / "pages/downloads" / name)
    return adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested
